name: A Season of War
text: Rally. (After this card is revealed in a province, add the top card of your dynasty deck to the province, faceup.) Action: Discard each card in each province, refilling each province faceup. End the dynasty phase. Then there is an additional dynasty phase, during which players do not collect fate.

name: Against the Waves
text: Action: Choose a Shugenja character you control – bow or ready that character. Errata from the Imperial Law (2020-01-06)

versions.flavor: Water is ever changing. A gentle wave one moment and a torrent of force the next.

name: Ancestral Shrine
text: Action: Return 1 or more rings from your claimed ring pool to the unclaimed ring pool - you gain 1 honor for each ring returned this way.

versions.flavor: The lights shine through the Yomi in the hopes of finding those they once knew.

name: Asako Azunami
text: Interrupt: When you would resolve the [element-water] ring – instead of the normal ring effect, you may choose and bow any character and you may choose and ready a different character.

name: Assassination
text: Conflict Action: Lose 3 honor. Choose a character with printed cost 2 or lower – discard that character. (Max 1 per round.)

versions.flavor: Steel whispered through silk and flesh. In the morning, they would find the body and speak of shadows and dishonor — but tonight, the deed was done.

name: Banzai!
text: Action: During a conflict, choose a participating character – that character gets +2[conflict-military] until the end of the conflict. You may lose 1 honor to resolve this ability twice. (Max 1 per conflict.)

name: Benten's Touch
text: Action: During a conflict, bow a (friendly) [clan-phoenix] Shugenja character. Choose a participating character you control – honor that character.

versions.flavor: "Blessed Benten, Lady of Love and Beauty, shine your radiance upon me. Let my hands work your beauty in the mortal realm and my words spread your grace to all."

name: City of the Rich Frog
text: Eminent. (This province starts the game faceup and cannot be turned facedown. It cannot be a stronghold province.) After setup, fill this province to 3 cards. When you would refill this province, refill it to 3 cards instead of 1.

name: Clarity of Purpose
text: Action: During a conflict, choose a character you control – until the end of that conflict, opponents' card effects cannot bow that character and it does not bow as a result of conflict resolution during [conflict-political] conflicts.

name: Court Games
text: [conflict-political] Conflict Action: Select one - either choose and honor a participating character you control, or your opponent chooses and dishonors a participating character they control. (Max 1 per conflict.)

versions.flavor: “We play today, so we can meet and play tomorrow.”

name: Display of Power
text: Reaction: After you lose an unopposed conflict – cancel the ring effect of that conflict. Then, you resolve that ring effect as if you had won the conflict as the attacking player. Claim that ring.

name: Emperor's Summons
text: Seeker role only. Reaction: After this province is revealed - search your dynasty deck for a character card and put it faceup into a non-stronghold province you control, discarding each other card in that province. Shuffle.

name: Entrenched Position
text: This province gets +5 strength during [conflict-military] conflicts.

versions.flavor: "It would take an entire Moto horde to break through here."
“These earthworks could withstand an entire Matsu legion.”

name: Ethereal Dreamer
text: Reaction: After the conflict phase begins, choose a ring – until the end of this phase, this character gets +2[conflict-military] and +2[conflict-political] while that ring is being contested.

name: Feral Ningyo
text: Action: During a [element-water] conflict – put this character into play from your hand in the conflict. At the end of the conflict, shuffle it into your conflict deck.

versions.flavor: The sea's embrace is cold and sharp.

name: Forebearer's Echoes
text: Air Role only. Action: During a [conflict-military] conflict, choose a character in your dynasty discard pile - put that character into play in the conflict. If that character is still in play at the end of the conflict, put it on the bottom of your dynasty deck.

name: Forgotten Library
text: Reaction: After the draw phase begins – draw 1 card.

versions.flavor: Truth cannot be lost, only forgotten.

name: Fushichō
text: No attachments. Interrupt: When this character leaves play, choose a [clan-phoenix] character in your dynasty pile – put that character into play with 1 fate on it.

name: Inferno Guard Invoker
text: Action: During a [conflict-military] conflict, choose a participating character you control - honor that character. If a province is broken during this conflict, sacrifice that character at the end of the conflict.

name: Isawa Heiko
text: Reaction: After you play a Water card, choose a character - switch that character's base [conflict-military] and [conflict-political] skill until the end of the phase.

versions.flavor: "How can you not find beauty in water's frozen crystal?"

name: Isawa Tadaka
text: [clan-crab] and [clan-phoenix] only. Disguised Shugenja. Action: During a conflict, remove one or more characters in your dynasty discard pile from the game - look at that many random cards from your opponent's hand. Choose and discard one of those cards.

name: Isawa Tsuke
text: Pride. Action: During a conflict, if the [element-fire] ring is in the unclaimed ring pool, lose 1 or more honor. Choose an equals number of participating characters - remove 1 fate from each of those characters.

name: Kudaka
text: Reaction: After you claim the [element-air] ring – gain 1 fate and draw 1 card. (Limit twice per round.)

versions.flavor: "It's tradition, this, just askin' the kami for their aid."

name: Kyūden Isawa
text: Action: During a conflict, bow this stronghold and discard a Spell event from your hand – play a Spell event from your conflict discard pile as if it were in your hand. Remove that event from the game. Errata from the Imperial Law (2020-01-06)

name: Miya Mystic
text: Action: During the conflict phase, sacrifice this character. Choose an attachment – discard that attachment.

versions.flavor: "Most of my family speak to the citizens of the Empire. I speak to the kami of the land itself."
“The Miya motto speaks truth — there are no Miya heroes, only servants of balance. Today, I serve by returning chaos to order.”

name: My Ancestor's Strength
text: Action: During a conflict, choose a participating Shugenja character you control and a character in your dynasty discard pile – until the end of the conflict, set the participating character's base [conflict-military] and [conflict-political] skill equal to the printed [conflict-military] and [conflict-political] skill of the other character.

name: Pacifism
text: Peaceful. (This card cannot be played during a conflict.) Attached character cannot participate in [conflict-military] conflicts.

versions.flavor: A peaceful environment leads to a peaceful mind.
In Crane courts and Phoenix temples alike, the gentle path is honored above all.

name: Pilgrimage
text: During conflicts at this province, cancel all ring effects. (If this province breaks, resolve ring effects as normal.)

versions.flavor:
“Faith is the greatest armor. The Seppun understand this as they guard the Empress — and as they brave the mountain's elemental trials.”
— Teachings of the Imperial Guard

name: Retire to the Brotherhood
text: Reaction: After this province is revealed - each player discards each character they control with no fate, reveals cards from the top of their dynasty deck until an equal number of characters are revealed, and puts those characters into play. Shuffle.

name: Seeker of Air
text: You may replace 1 province of any element with an additional [element-air] province while deckbuilding. Reaction: After an [element-air] province you control is revealed – gain 1 fate.

name: Shiba Pureheart
text: Rally. (After this card is revealed in a province, add the top card of your dynasty deck to the province, faceup.) Reaction: After an opponent declares their second conflict against you this phase, choose a character - honor that character.

name: Solemn Scholar
text: Conflict Action: Even from home, if the [element-earth] ring is in your claimed ring pool, choose an attacking character – bow that character.

versions.flavor: “The Isawa have mastered the elements for a thousand years. I am but one student, yet through me flows the wisdom of countless generations.”

name: Supernatural Storm
text: Action: Choose a participating character – that character gets +X[conflict-military] and +X[conflict-political] until the end of the conflict. X is equal to the number of Shugenja characters you control.

name: Walking the Way
text: If you control a Shugenja character, reduce the cost to play this card by 1. Action: Look at the top 3 cards of your dynasty deck. Discard a card from a province you control, and put one of the looked at cards into that province faceup. Shuffle.

name: Way of the Phoenix
text: Action: Choose a ring and an opponent – that player cannot declare conflicts of that ring's element this phase. (Max 1 per phase.)

versions.flavor: Master the elements and be reborn.
"Does the child not have a right to define the future they wish to see?"
